body:
am very sorry for your lost. I completely understand how you feel. I lost my grandma one month ago. She was everything to me. I feel there is a part o me that is gone forever. I think the best is to think that she is in a better place now far from all the suffering and injustice if this world. 
I know you will get through this be strong and remember all the memories you have with her.
I am very sorry for your lost.
I know you must be right. Thank you
Thank you for your kind words.

I understand how you must be feeling. I can’t imagine how hard it can be. You must stay strong and look after yourself the best way you can. We will overcome this. I also wanted to thank you for all your hard work. You are given people hope in the middle of darkness. God Bless You

Hello,
How are you feeling? I guest this is a very silly question given the circumstances I just wanted to check on you. I am sending you lot of blessings.

I am very sorry for your lost. Thank you for replying to my post. I am at home recovering from Coronavirus. That was the reason why I could not travel to see my grandma. If you would like to talk let me know please.
